subject.title: fix(browser): snapshots fail when managed proxy is enabled

question: Should OpenClaw approve bypassing managed proxy routing only for the validated configured local CDP discovery routes and their returned WebSocket endpoint during Playwright attachment?
rationale: This is an intentional security-boundary contract rather than a mechanical correctness choice: it balances browser usability under managed proxy against SSRF and proxy-policy enforcement.

options.title: Approve the narrow CDP bypass
options.body: Merge after the browser/proxy owner confirms that validated discovery and exact WebSocket leases are the intended boundary.

options.title: Require a different boundary
options.body: Pause for a maintainer-defined policy if bypasses should be limited further or handled through a different proxy integration.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow CDP bypass
recommendation.body: Merge after the browser/proxy owner confirms that validated discovery and exact WebSocket leases are the intended boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the merged loopback CDP proxy-bypass baseline that the new attachment-path behavior extends.
